prose: A Wall Street Journal report that YouTube is rolling out tools for microdramas, an AI storytelling assistant for script analysis, and video features, as it battles Netflix for top talent. The body is paywalled and was not captured, so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: YouTube is courting creators with both new formats (short serialized microdrama, huge in Asia) and AI tooling for the writing process - an arms race with Netflix for the same talent pool. Pricing, availability and partner names are unknown from the capture.
highlights: YouTube launches microdrama tools and an AI storytelling assistant, per WSJ
The AI assistant analyzes scripts; other video tools bundled
Framed as a talent battle with Netflix
